name: BASELINE
theoretical_role: Reference estimate for all paired condition-vs-baseline comparisons.

name: ADOPT_BASELINE
description: Endogenous tier choice under the baseline economy: founders start unaided and pick tiers from experienced ROI, posted prices, and peer signals.
theoretical_role: The adoption equilibrium itself: if the market sorts away from frontier AI while mid tiers persist, the equilibrium prices the trap that the fixed-tier design identifies causally. Anchor cell for the family.

name: ADOPT_FREE_AI
description: Endogenous tier choice with all AI subscription and usage costs at zero.
theoretical_role: Separates price-avoidance from trap-avoidance in the adoption equilibrium: if founders shun frontier AI only because it is expensive, free frontier AI should sweep the market; if the trap is epistemic, adoption rises and the population pays in survival instead of fees.

name: ADOPT_SUBSCRIPTION_ERA
description: Endogenous tier choice under subscription-era pricing (seat fees plus metered usage) in place of the usage-based default.
theoretical_role: Adoption-side mirror of SUBSCRIPTION_ERA: does the contractual seat-fee architecture, with its high trial gate, change the equilibrium mix relative to buying intelligence at the margin?

name: ADOPT_ERROR_FREE
description: Endogenous tier choice with hallucination and overconfidence removed from all AI tiers.
theoretical_role: Adoption-side mirror of NO_AI_ERRORS: tests whether error-free instruments change tier demand through experienced consequences rather than instrument quality alone.

name: ADOPT_NO_CROWDING
description: Endogenous tier choice with competition dynamics and convex crowding dilution disabled.
theoretical_role: Adoption-side mirror of NO_CROWDING: with the market-punishment channel removed, frontier ROI improves mechanically — does adoption recover toward the high tiers? Locates how much of the equilibrium's frontier-avoidance is learned crowding cost.

name: ADOPT_COST_2X
description: Endogenous tier choice with all AI costs doubled.
theoretical_role: Price-elasticity arm of the adoption family: bounds how the equilibrium mix responds to the most contested assumption (pricing) in the direction opposite ADOPT_FREE_AI.

name: ADOPT_STRATEGIES_ALL
description: Endogenous tier choice with the full strategic repertoire (consensus discounting, comparative advantage, complement-seeking) active for every founder.
theoretical_role: Tests whether strategic sophistication changes what the market learns to buy: if strategies cannot rescue frontier survival (P1/P8), sophisticated founders should not adopt frontier AI at higher rates either.

name: ADOPT_FAST_LEARNING
description: Endogenous tier choice with monthly tier reviews after a 6-round initial freeze (default: every 3 rounds after 12).
theoretical_role: Sorting-speed bound: a faster-learning market should reach the same equilibrium mix sooner if the equilibrium reflects experienced consequences; a different mix would mean the equilibrium is cadence-dependent.

name: ADOPT_SLOW_LEARNING
description: Endogenous tier choice with tier reviews every 6 rounds after an 18-round initial freeze.
theoretical_role: Sorting-speed bound in the slow direction; together with ADOPT_FAST_LEARNING brackets the learning-cadence assumption.

name: HUMAN_BASELINE_WEAK
description: Unaided founders' published characteristics lowered to quality 0.15 / breadth 0.12 (default 0.25 / 0.20); AI tiers unchanged.
theoretical_role: Lower bracket of the unaided-search anchor: shows whether the frontier trap's magnitude depends on how weak the no-AI comparison group is assumed to be.

name: HUMAN_BASELINE_STRONG
description: Unaided founders' published characteristics raised to quality 0.35 / breadth 0.30; AI tiers unchanged.
theoretical_role: Upper bracket of the unaided-search anchor: a stronger unaided floor narrows the first-order information gap — if the trap shrinks proportionally, it is information-gap-driven; if not, the anchor was not doing hidden work.

name: NO_AI_BIAS
description: Systematic bias term removed from all AI estimates (AI_BIAS_INTENSITY=0); hallucination and overconfidence unchanged.
theoretical_role: Isolates the systematic-bias channel while leaving hallucination and overconfidence unchanged.

name: WEALTH_SCALED_COMPUTE
description: Analysis breadth scales with founder resources (visibility budget x clamp(capital/initial equity, 0.25, 4.0)), uniformly across tiers; extra analyses billed per use.
theoretical_role: The rich-get-richer marginal-compute dynamic as a direct experiment rather than a design exclusion: if early winners buying more analysis could invert the frontier trap, this cell is where it would show.
